notes.title: Play The Free Demo of Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance Today!
notes.content:
Since its release on June 14th, Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance has received positive reviews from critics and fans alike! To allow as many people as possible to enjoy this title, we have released a free demo of the full game:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3185590/Shin_Megami_Tensei_V_Vengeance_Demo/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900578/fd8197745ad534f875d9dfe7b14326627ad10db7.gif

In this demo, you can explore the vast opening region and experience many elements of gameplay found throughout the story.

 Choose between two story paths, the brand-new story “Canon of Vengeance” or the original story from SMTV “Canon of Creation”
 Explore a post-apocalyptic Tokyo, now reduced to an expansive wasteland called Da’at
 Challenge up to four story bosses and enjoy around 20 subquests!
 Face up to six demon-infested obstacles to overcome and unlock more godly abilities
 Encounter a wide variety of demons along your journey to recruit and create the ultimate battle team! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900578/a0775f19f92d42e0b0c2bdc98c86a67c0d4583f3.gif

The save data from the demo can be used to continue your progress in the full version with the same story and character status.

====
Regarding the save data, the full game will automatically recognize and load save data from the demo.
*Please note that if you play the demo after playing the full version, the save data for the full version may be overwritten.
====

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900578/88d9a4abbbaa2c797fd3fba75260a80a36a758a5.gif

When a grisly murder scene in modern-day Tokyo blocks our protagonist’s walk home, an unplanned detour leaves him buried and unconscious. He awakens in a new Tokyo, a wasteland ravaged by apocalypse, now called Da’at. After wandering around, he suddenly runs into a mysterious man and fuses with him, becoming a mighty demigod known as a “Nahobino”.

Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance features two story paths to choose from, an engaging battle system, hundreds of demons to battle and recruit, and many areas to explore. The content can be enjoyed by players of all skill levels, from newcomers to veterans. 

We hope you enjoy the free demo of Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance!

notes.title: Free DLC Update - Ver. 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900578/b8daebaea843098a09bd52c8a634a06940738d88.jpg
Dear Shin Megami Tensei fans, thank you for playing Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance!

Patch version 1.0.3 has been released and brings a new content update and minor bug fixes. Please see below for details:

Content additions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900578/40a92045b6c03abf4d79a02c29805b0322107693.png
Six new Demon Navigators have been added based on your community vote!
 Mara, Idun, Mothman, Fionn mac Cumhaill, Hell Biker, and Cleopatra have been added.
 These demons will appear at specific points in Da’at and can accompany you as Demon Navigators when spoken to.
※ Some Demon Navigators can only be unlocked by completing specific subquests.

The subquest “The Guardian of Light” has been added.
 Da'at: You can accept the sub-quest by speaking to Goko in Taito Ward.

The brand-new demon, Marici of the Kishin race, has been added.
 Marici can be recruited  and unlocked for fusion by completing the subquest “The Guardian of Light”.

The “Elite Virtual Trainers”  have been added.
 After completing certain subquests, you can take on a series of brutal battles against the powerful demons that appeared in those subquests by speaking to the female researcher in the terminal room at the Tokyo Diet Building.

Bug Fixes

 Various text fixes.
 Various graphical fixes.
 Some fixes to English voiceover.
 Other performance-related fixes.

Thank you again for your continued support, patience, and feedback!

notes.title: Metaphor: ReFantazio Out Now!
notes.content:
The creative minds behind Persona 3, Persona 4, and Persona 5 proudly present ATLUS' latest fantasy RPG: Metaphor: ReFantazio!

Join the Protagonist on a journey alongside his fairy companion, Gallica, to lift the curse from the kingdom’s lost prince. Control your destiny, face your fears, and awaken magical "Archetype" powers that lie dormant in your heart.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2679460/Metaphor_ReFantazio/

[previewyoutube=HnRzo99OqxU;full][/previewyoutube]--
Try the Prologue Demo!
Download and play the free Prologue Demo! The demo allows you to experience the beginning of the game, including exploring the first four dungeons, the ability to unlock seven Archetypes classes, and the opportunity to meet six followers. Best yet, your demo save data carries over to the full version.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3130330/Metaphor_ReFantazio__Prologue_Demo/

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Dear Shin Megami Tensei fans, thank you for playing Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance!

The latest patch "Ver. 1.0.2" has been released to fix major / minor bugs and improve overall gameplay. Please see below for details.

Fixes

 Fixed issue where the controller became inoperable when playing across multiple devices.
 Fixed issue where there was a low possibility of the game becoming unresponsive upon startup.
 Fixed issue where progression in the game became impossible upon meeting certain criteria.
 Fixed text-related issues.
 Fixed graphics-related issues.
 Fixed other functional issues.

In addition, several new demon navigators will also be implemented in future updates! Please look forward to further details.

Thank you again for your continued support, patience, and feedback.

notes.title: Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance has arrived!
notes.content:
Hi Nahobinos, Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance is finally here! To celebrate, we wanted to present a special launch artwork from Character Designer Masayuki Doi!

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GQDP6s7X0AAwWPK?format=jpg&name=large

---
Slipknot x SMTV:V

In the leadup to launch, we collaborated with legendary heavy metal band Slipknot on the creation of three masks based on in-game demons. Check out our interview with band members Clown, Eloy, & new guy discussing the connections between the demons in SMTV:V and their music.

[previewyoutube=j-C2n5lrLfc;full][/previewyoutube]
If you thought the masks looked cool, well guess what? You can OWN one! Enter our sweepstakes for the chance to win one of the three custom masks: https://gleam.io/xIaok/shin-megami-tensei-v-vengeance-x-slipknot-demon-mask-sweepstakes


---
Demon Personality Quiz

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GQD1I6MbEAID1BT?format=jpg&name=large

Which Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance demon are you most like? 🤔 

Answer our quiz as if you were a demon to find out! https://atlus.link/SMTVV-Demon-Quiz 

---
Launch Trailer

We wanted to leave you with a final look at our launch trailer. It's time to ascend to Godhood and return balance to a decimated Tokyo!

[previewyoutube=esJS9uV4qYM;full][/previewyoutube]
Thank you for coming with us on this journey. Best of luck in your adventures in Da'at! 😈
